post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: What actually happened on this call. booked when a technician visit was written to the schedule. estimate_request when a replacement estimate was logged for the sales team and no visit was booked. out_of_area when the property postcode was outside the service area and nothing was dispatched. transferred when the caller was handed to a person. message_taken when the assistant took a name and a number for the office to call back. spam when the call was a sales pitch, a recorded message or a robocall. voicemail when the call reached a machine or nobody ever spoke. abandoned when the caller hung up part way through and none of the above had happened yet.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgency
post_call_analysis_data.description: The urgency the assistant settled on for this call, taken from the triage_problem result. emergency for no heat, a suspected gas leak, a carbon monoxide alarm or water coming from the system. urgent for no cooling or an unusual noise or burning smell. routine for a tune up, a filter or a thermostat fault. quote when the caller wanted a price on a replacement system. unknown when the call ended before the problem was triaged, or the call was spam or a wrong number.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_area_ok
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if check_service_area confirmed the property postcode is inside the service area. False if the postcode came back outside the area, and false if the postcode was never checked on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: technician_paged
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if notify_on_call reported that the on call technician was paged for this call. False if the job was queued for the morning dispatch, if no booking was made, or if notify_on_call was never reached.
